author: The Current
description:
Watch The Union feat. Phil Cook perform "There Was a Time" live in an Eau Claire coffeehouse
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

When the Eaux Claires Festival returned in the summer of 2026, The Current and Radio Milwaukee teamed up for a live broadcast from Shift Coffee Bar in Eau Claire, Wisconsin.

On Saturday, July 25, just one day after performing an uplifting set at the Eaux Claires Festival at Carson Park, The Union feat. Phil Cook showed up bright and early at SHIFT to a set of three songs, including the original, "There Was a Time," off their 2025 album, "Eclectic."

Watch a performance of "There Was a Time" above.
